skills.name: gtm-brief
skills.title: Build a GTM brief
skills.description: Create or revise an operational GTM brief from company, offer, buyer, goals and constraints. Use at the start of an engagement or when context changes; not for campaign performance diagnosis.

skills.name: gtm-icp
skills.title: Define an evidence-based ICP
skills.description: Define or refine ideal customer and buyer criteria from customer and sales evidence. Use for segmentation and audience design; not grading records against an established rubric.

skills.name: gtm-positioning
skills.title: Develop positioning and offer messaging
skills.description: Develop positioning, value propositions and offer language from buyer evidence and actual alternatives. Use for offer clarity and differentiation; not full outreach cadence design.

skills.name: gtm-diagnose
skills.title: Diagnose a GTM performance problem
skills.description: Diagnose a specific GTM performance problem from company context, funnel evidence and raw examples. Use for flat pipeline or weak conversion; not routine weekly reporting.

skills.name: gtm-account-sourcing
skills.title: Source a target-account list
skills.description: Find or assemble target accounts from an agreed audience using accessible approved sources. Use for company sourcing and coverage planning; not personal contact enrichment.

skills.name: gtm-account-research
skills.title: Research a target account
skills.description: Research a named company for a specific GTM question using accessible sources. Use for account dossiers and account-specific hypotheses; not bulk contact enrichment.

skills.name: gtm-buyer-map
skills.title: Map a buying group
skills.description: Map users, champions, owners and approvers at a named account using current organizational evidence. Use for buying-group research; not mass email discovery.

skills.name: gtm-enrichment-plan
skills.title: Plan and audit enrichment
skills.description: Plan or audit enrichment of existing contact/account records with identity checks, supplier constraints and verification states. Use for specific data gaps; not company sourcing or sending.

skills.name: gtm-data-inspect
skills.title: Inspect prospect data
skills.description: Inspect prospect exports for column ambiguity, missing evidence, malformed values and duplicate identities. Use before qualification or imports; not live CRM cleanup.

skills.name: gtm-qualify
skills.title: Qualify accounts and buyers
skills.description: Assess company and person fit against an explicit evidence-based rubric. Use for prospect qualification; not signal ordering or market sizing.

skills.name: gtm-prioritize
skills.title: Prioritize a prospect queue
skills.description: Order an already-qualified prospect or opportunity queue using explicit preferences, demand and dated signals. Use to choose the next work; not to establish fit or predict purchase probability.

skills.name: gtm-signal-design
skills.title: Design actionable signal rules
skills.description: Design GTM event definitions, source coverage, freshness and review actions. Use before building monitoring or event routing; not ranking individual prospects.

skills.name: gtm-draft
skills.title: Write grounded outreach
skills.description: Write or revise first-touch email/direct-message drafts from supplied buyer context, offer and evidence. Use for exact copy; not cadence scheduling or live sending.

skills.name: gtm-sequence-design
skills.title: Design an outreach sequence
skills.description: Design multistep outreach channel logic, waits, reply handling and stop conditions. Use for cadence architecture; not message copy alone or unrequested enrollment.

skills.name: gtm-review
skills.title: Review campaign readiness
skills.description: Review an outreach pack for identity, fit, suppression, sender, copy, schedule and blockers. Use before campaign handoff or launch; does not launch or certify compliance.

skills.name: gtm-crm-hygiene
skills.title: Audit CRM data and repairs
skills.description: Audit CRM records for duplicate identity, lifecycle, ownership and relationship problems. Use for hygiene and repair planning; not cosmetic export formatting or unsolicited live merges.

skills.name: gtm-deliverability
skills.title: Investigate email delivery
skills.description: Investigate sender, authentication, bounce and delivery evidence for a reported email problem. Use for troubleshooting; not inbox-placement guarantees or automatic infrastructure changes.

skills.name: gtm-reply-triage
skills.title: Triage sales conversations
skills.description: Triage supplied or connected sales threads and draft context-aware responses. Use for inbox review; not new outreach or automatic sending.

skills.name: gtm-meeting-handoff
skills.title: Prepare a meeting handoff
skills.description: Prepare an accurate sales meeting brief and ownership handoff from conversations and account evidence. Use after interest or booking; not calendar scheduling.

skills.name: gtm-pipeline-analysis
skills.title: Analyze funnel and pipeline
skills.description: Analyze pipeline, campaign or opportunity exports with defined cohorts, denominators and time windows. Use for performance analysis; not unsupported causal attribution.

skills.name: gtm-experiment
skills.title: Design and evaluate a GTM test
skills.description: Design a bounded GTM experiment or evaluate it against a declared decision rule. Use for audience, offer, channel or copy tests; not retrospective winner selection from uncontrolled changes.

skills.name: gtm-linkedin-content
skills.title: Plan and write LinkedIn content
skills.description: Plan or draft LinkedIn posts from actual author expertise, evidence and audience needs. Use for original professional content; not automated engagement or unrequested publishing.

skills.name: gtm-content-repurpose
skills.title: Repurpose supported content
skills.description: Adapt existing source material into GTM posts, emails, briefs or carousel outlines while preserving meaning and attribution. Use for repurposing; not original research or automatic publishing.

skills.name: gtm-workflow-design
skills.title: Design a GTM automation workflow
skills.description: Design, review or debug GTM automation with data contracts, state, identity and failure handling. Use for workflow architecture; not claiming that a diagram implements an integration.

skills.name: gtm-operating-review
skills.title: Run a GTM operating review
skills.description: Prepare a periodic GTM review from metrics, commitments and prior decisions. Use for weekly cadence and ownership; not inventing progress or replacing a focused diagnosis.
